about: The first three digits of a US ZIP Code and the state they belong to, from USPS's ZIP Code prefix ranges by state. Each range is [first, last, USPS code], both ends included. A range follows USPS's block for its state, so a prefix inside a block that holds no ZIP Code today (213 in Maryland's, for one) still gives that state; a prefix between blocks that USPS has not given out is left out. AA, AE and AP are military mail; GU, PR and VI are territories. Checked prefix by prefix on Nov 17, 2026 against two open ZIP-to-state lists. A few single ZIP Codes sit in another state than their prefix (06390 is in New York, 73960 in Texas, 83414 in Wyoming, 96799 in American Samoa); the table gives the prefix's own state. 888 holds one ZIP Code, 88888, which USPS files under DC. 969 also serves the Northern Mariana Islands, Palau, Micronesia and the Marshall Islands.
